description: 1 page, 12pt Helvetica re-encoded so the text layer holds real typographic code points: "ﬁgure" and "beneﬁt" (U+FB01), "ﬂat" (U+FB02), "Eﬀects" (U+FB00), "oﬃce" (U+FB03), "baﬄing" (U+FB04), "o\u00ADther" (soft hyphen) and "450\u00A0ms" (no-break space).
format: Per page: `lines` = expected buildLines(page).map(l => l.text) in reading order; `spoken` = text to speak with DEFAULT_FILTERS; `spokenReadEverything` = text to speak with READ_EVERYTHING; `skipped` = what DEFAULT_FILTERS drop. Spoken text joins lines with single spaces, de-hyphenates "-" + lowercase line starts, and is normalized (ligatures expanded, soft hyphens removed, NBSP/thin space -> space).
notes: pdf.js (getTextContent with disableNormalization: true) keeps U+FB00-FB04 in item.str, maps the no-break space to a plain space, and drops U+00AD entirely (it skips Unicode format characters), so "o\u00ADther" extracts as "other".
